messages.content: You are a computational biologist. Given a CRISPR screen description, produce a ranked list of 100 gene symbols (HGNC nomenclature for Homo sapiens) that you believe are MOST LIKELY to be hits in this screen, ordered strongest first. Use only your knowledge of biology — no chain-of-thought in the output. Return ONLY a comma-separated list of 100 symbols, no prose, no numbering.

## Goal

You are tasked with ranking genes from a genetic perturbation screen. Based on the experimental context and hit criteria provided below, provide a list of exactly 100 genes that are hits in this screen, ranked from strongest to weakest according to the criteria defined below.

## Experimental Context

This screen was performed in HeLa RelA-mNeonGreen cells, a Cervical Adenocarcinoma Cell Line. Researchers used a CRISPRn library (Knockout) to systematically perturb gene function. The experiment followed a Cytokine exposure design and was conducted over 60 Minutes under IFN-β (Interferon beta) treatment (75 ng/µL).

## Screen Objective

The primary objective of this screen was to identify a set of hit genes, each of which either increases or decreases RelA nuclear translocation upon TNFα stimulation.

## Hit Definition

A gene is classified as a "hit" if its Knockout significantly either increases or decreases RelA nuclear translocation upon TNFα stimulation. The statistical criterion for significance is: Score.1 (Z-score) < 0.0 AND Score.2 (FDR) < 0.01 OR Score.1 (Z-score) > 0.0 AND Score.2 (FDR) < 0.01.

## Ranking Criteria

Genes with low Z-score, low FDR (decrease RelA nuclear translocation upon TNFα stimulation) OR high Z-score, low FDR (increase RelA nuclear translocation upon TNFα stimulation) are ranked most highly.

## Additional Context
Screen notes: A genome-wide CRISPR screen was combined with high-speed image-enabled cell sorting (ICS) to quantify the nuclear translocation of fluorescently tagged RelA upon NF-kB pathway activation by TFNalpha. Positive regulators of RelA nuclear translocation are enriched (negative Z-score) and negative regulators are depleted (positive Z-score) (FDR < 1%)

## Required Output Format

Provide your response as an ordered list of exactly 100 HGNC gene symbols, using the ranking criteria above.
That is, top genes should have low Z-score, low FDR (decrease RelA nuclear translocation upon TNFα stimulation) OR high Z-score, low FDR (increase RelA nuclear translocation upon TNFα stimulation).

Format: 
GENE1, GENE2, GENE3, ..., GENE100

=== Final instruction ===
Return ONLY a comma-separated list of 100 gene symbols (no prose, no numbers, no markdown). All gene symbols must use the HGNC convention for Homo sapiens (e.g. 'TP53' for HGNC, 'Trp53' for MGI). Do not return symbols from another organism.
